vendors.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
vendors.tagline: Azure analytics service with SQL pools and Spark. Microsoft points new work to Fabric.
vendors.verdictNote: Synapse SQL pools have no semantic layer object, and Microsoft puts its AI and semantic work into Fabric and Power BI.

artifacts.name: Primary key and unique constraints (NOT ENFORCED)
artifacts.format: T-SQL DDL; dedicated SQL pool accepts these keys only as NOT ENFORCED

artifacts.name: Data Discovery and Classification (sensitivity labels)
artifacts.format: Portal, T-SQL ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION, Azure CLI, REST API

artifacts.name: Microsoft Purview scan of dedicated SQL pools
artifacts.format: Separate Purview service; scans metadata and applies classifications

metrics.n: No metric object in SQL pools. Teams define measures in Power BI semantic models, dbt, or Cube.

dimensions.n: No hierarchy or time grain object in SQL pools. Teams declare dimensions in a Power BI model or dbt.

relationships.n: Dedicated pool allows primary key and unique constraints only as NOT ENFORCED. They document keys but do not enforce them.

synonyms.n: Docs for sp_addextendedproperty do not list Synapse. Teams keep descriptions and synonyms in Purview or a data dictionary.

verifiedQueries.n: No store for question and SQL pairs. Teams keep them in the NL-to-SQL tool they build or buy.

nl2sql.n: No Copilot or NL-to-SQL in Synapse SQL pools. Copilot for Fabric Warehouse generates T-SQL and is in Preview.

ontology.n: No ontology object. Fabric IQ ontology is a Fabric item, not a Synapse feature.

graph.n: No graph query in Synapse SQL pools or Synapse Spark. Synapse Data Explorer, the KQL engine, is retired.

vector.n: The dedicated SQL pool data type page lists no vector type. Teams use Azure AI Search or another store.

mcp.n: The Azure MCP Server tool list has no Synapse namespace. Teams use a custom or partner MCP server over T-SQL.

governance.n: Dedicated pool has row-level security, column-level security, dynamic data masking, and sensitivity classification.

openStandard.n: No portable semantic format. Tables are standard T-SQL objects that other tools read.

aiDescriptions.n: No AI description feature found for SQL pools or Synapse Studio. Teams use an external catalog.

bulkMetadata.n: ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION, Azure CLI, and REST write labels. No documented T-SQL path for table and column descriptions.

autoClassify.n: Data Discovery and Classification suggests labels from patterns and keywords. A person reviews and applies them.

sampleValues.n: No NL-to-SQL feature, so no value matching. Teams build value lookup in their own agent.

queryHistory.n: No feature mines query history for joins or metrics. Request views exist for monitoring only.

lineage.n: Purview captures table lineage from Synapse pipeline Copy and Data Flow runs. Its source table shows no lineage for dedicated pools.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL accuracy tooling in Synapse. Teams use an open source eval set with their own agent.

offers: Dedicated SQL pools hold data in distributed T-SQL tables that any BI or agent tool can query.
Serverless SQL pools query files in the data lake with T-SQL views.
Data Discovery and Classification labels sensitive columns, and audit logs record queries on labeled columns.
Row-level security, column-level security, and dynamic data masking limit what a query returns.
Microsoft publishes migration tools and guides from Synapse to Fabric Data Warehouse and Fabric Spark.
gaps: Synapse SQL pools have no Copilot or NL-to-SQL feature. The Fabric Warehouse Copilot is in Preview.
Primary keys are NOT ENFORCED, and no join metadata reaches an AI agent.
The Azure MCP Server has no Synapse tool.
Synapse Data Explorer was retired on 2025-10-07. Synapse Link for Cosmos DB ends in March 2029.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Do not build new NL-to-SQL on Synapse SQL pools. Move the tables to Fabric Data Warehouse, or keep them in place and build a Power BI semantic model over them. Then use Copilot or a Fabric data agent on that model.

snippet.title: Key constraint on a dedicated SQL pool table (not enforced)

vendors.enrichHowTo: Synapse SQL pools have no documented comment or description statement for tables and columns. Keep descriptions in Microsoft Purview or in a Power BI model. Use ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION to label sensitive columns in bulk.

bulkSnippet.code:
ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION TO dbo.Customers.Email
WITH (LABEL = 'Confidential', INFORMATION_TYPE = 'Contact Info', RANK = MEDIUM);

vendors.name: Azure Data Explorer and Fabric Eventhouse
vendors.tagline: Real-time analytics engine with KQL, sold as an Azure service and as Fabric Eventhouse.
vendors.verdictNote: KQL databases have docstrings, stored functions, and Copilot with saved example pairs, but no metric or relationship objects.

artifacts.name: Docstrings on tables, columns, and functions
artifacts.format: KQL control commands: .alter table docstring, .alter table column-docstrings

artifacts.name: Copilot for writing KQL queries
artifacts.format: UI in KQL queryset and Real-Time Dashboards; works with Eventhouse and with ADX clusters through Fabric capacity

artifacts.name: Private Shots (saved natural language and KQL pairs)
artifacts.format: Automatic. Saved querysets and Real-Time Dashboards publish KQL queries to a Private Shots database. Docs show no stage label

artifacts.name: Fabric RTI MCP server (local, open source)
artifacts.format: Self-hosted MCP server for Eventhouse, Eventstream, Activator, Map, and ADX; PyPI package microsoft-fabric-rti-mcp

artifacts.name: Eventhouse remote MCP server
artifacts.format: Hosted HTTP MCP endpoint; schema discovery, NL-to-KQL, data sampling

artifacts.name: Azure MCP Server, Azure Data Explorer tools
artifacts.format: MCP tools to list clusters, view databases, and query data with natural language or KQL

artifacts.name: Graph semantics: graph models and snapshots
artifacts.format: KQL make-graph and graph-match for transient graphs; .create graph_model for persistent labeled property graphs. Docs show no preview label

artifacts.name: Vector functions: series_cosine_similarity and ai_embeddings plugin
artifacts.format: KQL function for cosine similarity; ai_embeddings plugin is Preview; Vector16 encoding policy saves storage

metrics.n: No metric object. Teams package reusable logic in stored functions and materialized views.

dimensions.n: No hierarchy or time grain object. Teams model dimensions in Power BI or in KQL functions.

relationships.n: No foreign keys. A graph model can define node and edge links between tables.

synonyms.n: Docstrings on tables, columns, and functions guide Copilot. Docs call them critical for columns with unclear names.

verifiedQueries.n: Private Shots store question and KQL pairs from saved querysets. Data agent also takes example queries for Eventhouse.

nl2sql.n: Copilot in KQL queryset writes KQL from questions (GA). ADX clusters need a Fabric capacity for Copilot.

ontology.n: Fabric IQ ontology is a separate Preview item. Data agent docs list KQL as a source query language for it.

graph.n: KQL has make-graph, graph-match, and persistent graph models with snapshots. Docs show no preview label.

vector.n: series_cosine_similarity ranks stored embeddings. The ai_embeddings plugin that creates embeddings in a query is Preview.

mcp.n: Local RTI, remote Eventhouse, and Azure MCP Server for ADX are all Preview.

governance.n: Row level security policy limits rows by caller. Purview lists classifications and sensitivity labels for ADX.

openStandard.n: No portable semantic model format found. KQL stored functions and docstrings stay inside the database.

aiDescriptions.n: Copilot docs list query writing and dashboards. They do not list drafting of docstrings.

bulkMetadata.n: .alter table column-docstrings sets many column descriptions in one command. The merge form keeps existing ones.

autoClassify.n: Purview scans ADX and applies classifications and sensitivity labels. Purview is a separate service.

sampleValues.n: The Eventhouse MCP server samples data (Preview). Copilot docs do not describe literal matching.

queryHistory.n: Copilot learns from saved querysets and dashboards that you publish, not from query history.

lineage.n: The Purview Data Map source table shows no lineage for Azure Data Explorer.

evals.n: Like and dislike icons send feedback to Microsoft. No NL-to-KQL accuracy test tool found.

offers: Copilot turns a question into KQL in a KQL queryset or Real-Time Dashboard and supports follow-up questions.
Private Shots add your saved KQL queries, including graph and stored function calls, as examples for Copilot.
Docstrings on tables and columns give Copilot business meaning. One command sets many column docstrings.
MCP servers let agents discover schema, sample data, and run KQL. All three servers are in Preview.
KQL has graph operators, persistent graph models, and vector similarity functions in the same query language.
gaps: No metric, dimension, or relationship objects. Reusable logic lives in stored functions and materialized views.
Copilot for ADX clusters needs a Fabric-enabled capacity. Trial capacity is not supported.
All MCP servers for ADX and Eventhouse are Preview. The ai_embeddings plugin is Preview.
No lineage for ADX in the Purview Data Map source table, and no NL-to-KQL accuracy test tool.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Add docstrings to the tables and columns that users ask about. Use Copilot in a KQL queryset and save good queries so they become Private Shots. For agents, connect the Eventhouse MCP server or add the Eventhouse as a Fabric data agent source with example queries.

snippet.title: KQL docstrings for a table and its columns
snippet.code:
.alter table Sales docstring "One row per order line."

.alter-merge table Sales column-docstrings (
    Amount: "Net sales in USD",
    Region: "Sales region name"
)

vendors.enrichHowTo: Set docstrings with .alter table docstring and .alter-merge table column-docstrings. The merge form keeps existing column docstrings. Copilot reads docstrings, so add them first to tables and columns with unclear names.

bulkSnippet.code:
.alter-merge table Sales column-docstrings (
    Amount: "Net sales in USD",
    Region: "Sales region name"
)

vendors.name: Power BI
vendors.tagline: Microsoft BI tool built on semantic models with DAX measures, Copilot, and MCP servers.
vendors.verdictNote: Power BI semantic models hold governed measures and relationships in open TMDL text, and Copilot and MCP servers read them, but Prep data for AI is Preview.

artifacts.name: Power BI semantic model (TMDL, DAX measures, relationships)
Prep data for AI: AI instructions, AI data schema, verified answers
artifacts.format: GUI in Desktop and service; saved on the semantic model. Verified answers allow up to three filters

artifacts.name: Q&A synonyms and linguistic schema
artifacts.format: Q&A setup in Desktop. Learn pages say Q&A experiences go away in February 2027

artifacts.name: Copilot in Power BI: ask data questions (with Fabric IQ)
artifacts.format: Copilot pane in the Power BI service; generates DAX and shows reasoning steps

artifacts.name: Fabric IQ MCP server
artifacts.format: Remote read-only MCP server for Power BI reports and semantic models; Entra ID sign-in

artifacts.name: Power BI Authoring MCP server (hosted)
artifacts.format: Remote MCP at https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp/powerbi/authoring; edits semantic models

artifacts.name: Power BI Authoring MCP server (local)
artifacts.format: Local stdio server for Power BI Desktop and PBIP files; supports service principals

artifacts.name: XMLA endpoint
artifacts.format: XMLA protocol; read-only by default on capacity workspaces, read-write when enabled

metrics.n: DAX measures live in the semantic model as TMDL or TOM objects, with formats and descriptions.

dimensions.n: Columns, hierarchies, display folders, and sort-by-column are declared in TMDL.

relationships.n: Model relationships are declared objects. Fabric IQ uses relationships in the semantic model.

synonyms.n: Descriptions and synonyms are model metadata. AI instructions are Preview, and Q&A synonyms go away in February 2027.

verifiedQueries.n: Verified answers bind trigger phrases to a visual with up to three filters (Preview). They need Q&A on.

nl2sql.n: Copilot answers data questions with DAX over the semantic model. Needs a paid Fabric capacity.

ontology.n: Fabric IQ ontology is a separate Preview item that can start from a semantic model.

graph.n: Power BI has no graph query. Graph in Fabric is a separate item.

vector.n: Copilot search finds reports and semantic models by meaning, using item metadata. Eventhouse in Fabric stores vectors for your own data.

mcp.n: Fabric IQ MCP is GA and read-only. The authoring MCP server is GA locally and Preview when hosted.

governance.n: Row-level and object-level security apply through Fabric IQ MCP. Sensitivity labels flow to downstream content.

openStandard.n: TMDL is a documented text format and XMLA is open. The Power BI Ossie converter is initial.

aiDescriptions.n: Copilot drafts measure descriptions from the DAX formula in Desktop and web modeling. Measures only.

bulkMetadata.n: TMDL, the XMLA endpoint, and the authoring MCP server edit many objects at once. Hosted MCP is Preview.

autoClassify.n: Purview sensitivity labels apply to semantic models and flow downstream. No column-level labels found for models.

sampleValues.n: Fabric IQ MCP offers value lookup. Instance value indexing needs the Q&A setting, which goes away in 2027.

queryHistory.n: No feature mines query history to suggest measures or joins. Q&A review of asked questions is part of the retiring Q&A.

lineage.n: Workspace lineage view shows items. Purview gives column lineage only when the source is Azure SQL Database.

evals.n: Docs tell you to test key questions by hand in Desktop. The data agent evaluation SDK is a separate Preview tool.

offers: A semantic model stores DAX measures, relationships, hierarchies, descriptions, and synonyms as TMDL files that work with Git.
Prep data for AI stores AI instructions, an AI data schema, and verified answers on the model (Preview).
Copilot answers questions with DAX over the model and shows its reasoning steps and the DAX query.
Fabric IQ MCP (GA) gives agents read-only schema lookup, value search, and DAX queries under the caller's security roles.
The Power BI Authoring MCP server edits tables, measures, and relationships in bulk, locally (GA) or hosted (Preview).
gaps: Q&A experiences go away in February 2027 per Learn, and Prep data for AI still needs Q&A turned on.
Verified answers bind to visuals, not to SQL or DAX text. Fabric IQ in the Copilot pane returns no verified answers.
Fabric IQ MCP has no natural language answer tool. The calling agent writes the DAX.
Copilot needs a paid Fabric capacity in a supported region. Trial SKUs do not work.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Build a clean semantic model with measure names, descriptions, and synonyms. Add AI instructions, an AI data schema, and verified answers in Prep data for AI, then test your top questions in Copilot. For agents, connect the Fabric IQ MCP server, and use the authoring MCP server to edit the model.

snippet.title: TMDL table with a description, a DAX measure and a relationship
snippet.code:
/// Sales fact table
table Sales

    /// Sum of quantity times net price
    measure 'Sales Amount' = SUMX('Sales', 'Sales'[Quantity] * 'Sales'[Net Price])
        formatString: $ #,##0

    column 'Product Key'
        dataType: int64
        isHidden
        sourceColumn: ProductKey

relationship cdb6e6a9-c9d1-42b9-b9e0-484a1bc7e123
    fromColumn: Sales.'Product Key'
    toColumn: Product.'Product Key'

vendors.enrichHowTo: Add descriptions and synonyms to tables, columns, and measures in the model. Draft measure descriptions with Copilot, then review them. For many objects, edit TMDL files, use the XMLA endpoint, or ask the Power BI Authoring MCP server to run a bulk operation.

openToOtherTools.n: The XMLA endpoint is read-only by default and read-write when enabled. Fabric IQ MCP works with any MCP client.
